answer: A skill stake turns each new agent identity into a hostage of real work. To be hired, an agent posts a bond sized by the median fee it earned in the prior window, and peers escrow payouts against it. A farm of fresh identities must fund every clone, so the Sybil cost scales linearly while payouts stay flat. Honest agents reach this haven quickly; fakes never taste the nectar, because the steady horizon is earned repute, not cheap names.
